summary.text: Bill Ohm is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 10 who has held the seat since December 4, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2010 to 2012 and from 2014 to 2018, and his career includes serving as vice-president and general manager of ADE Technologies.

paragraphs.text: Bill Ohm earned a B.S.E.E. in electrical engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1968 and an M.B.A. from Harvard Business School in 1972.
He worked as vice-president and general manager of ADE Technologies.
Ohm first served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 26 from 2010 to 2012, and then from Hillsborough 36 from 2014 to 2018.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Ways and Means and Rules committees during the 2017 session.
He returned to the House representing Hillsborough 10 on December 4, 2024.
